meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 OpenClaw 配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw configuration to NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

howto.what: Claude 会引导你把 OpenClaw 的老机器人搬到 NanoClaw v2：先检查现有安装，读取身份、频道配置、定时任务等，再和你讨论哪些要搬、放哪里，最后展示改动再应用。
howto.when: 当你说出 “migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration” 或 “import from openclaw” 时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
查看我的 OpenClaw 配置，告诉我哪些能迁过来
say.note: 它先做发现，再和你讨论迁移内容。

say.text: 我有定时任务和多个群，迁移时怎么安排？
say.note: 它会询问你如何处理这些项目。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through migrating an existing OpenClaw bot to NanoClaw v2: it finds the current install, reads identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, etc., then discusses what to migrate and where, showing proposed changes before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", or "import from openclaw".

say_en.text: Help me migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2.
say_en.note: Claude starts by checking your OpenClaw installation.

say_en.text: Review my OpenClaw config and tell me what can be moved.
say_en.note: It discovers and summarizes your current setup.

say_en.text: I have scheduled tasks and multiple groups—how do we handle them?
say_en.note: It asks you how to handle each area before proceeding.
